meta.name: cco-review
meta.description: /cs:cco-review <plan> — Retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer interrogation of any plan that touches customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or CS team hiring. Use when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查客户留存策略与团队规划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是负责客户成功的高管，需要评估留存与团队计划。
copy.tagline_en: Review customer retention strategies and team plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a customer success executive evaluating retention and team plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像一位首席客户官一样，对涉及客户留存、客户分层、客户成功团队规模和招聘的计划提出六道拷问，并输出一份包含留存、分层、覆盖、组织等维度的审查报告。
howto.when: 当你想审查客户留存率下滑、批准客户成功团队扩编、决定客户分层或是否保留某些客户时，使用命令 /cs:cco-review <计划> 触发。

say.text: 审查我们的客户留存计划，使用 /cs:cco-review 命令。
say.note: Claude 会运行六道拷问并生成报告。

say.text: 帮我分析客户分层方案，用 /cs:cco-review。
say.note: Claude 会检查分层是否合理，并建议需要淘汰的客户。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer, pressure-testing any plan related to customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or hiring, and outputs a review report covering retention, segmentation, coverage, and org.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command /cs:cco-review <plan> when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.

say_en.note: Claude runs six forcing questions and generates a report.
Claude checks segmentation and suggests customers to fire.
